criteria.description: Distinguishes TAM, SAM, and SOM rather than giving one undifferentiated market number.
Estimates the market BOTH top-down and bottom-up (not just one), as independent cross-checks.
States the assumptions/inputs behind the numbers (population, % who fit, price, frequency) rather than hiding multipliers.
Grounds SOM in realistically winnable share given competition/GTM/time, not 'we'll get 1% of a huge TAM'.
Reconciles the two estimates and/or gives a range plus the assumptions it's most sensitive to, instead of false precision.
